note.question: What determines behavior-based pricing (BBP) in a vertically differentiated model?
note.overview: This paper studies behavior-based pricing (BBP) in a vertically differentiated model. Vertical differentiation is innately asymmetric because all customers prefer the higher-quality product when prices are equal. This asymmetry causes BBP to have different properties than symmetric horizontally differentiated models.
